title: Settings
summary: Where to change themes, languages, backups, and Quick Guide behaviour.

cards.heading: What Settings does
cards.body: Settings controls how Iron Rabbit looks, sounds, and safeguards your data. Every change is saved on your device instantly.

cards.heading: Themes
cards.body: Choose Light for daytime, Moon for evenings, or Star for a night-sky feel. Every screen — even Kid Mode — respects your choice.

cards.heading: Backup and Restore
cards.body: Tap Backup & Restore to export everything as a single .json file. Nothing leaves your device unless you share the file yourself.

cards.heading: Tip: Enable Quick Guides on new screens
cards.body: Tip: Turn on 'Automatically show Quick Guides' below. The next time you open a screen for the first time, a friendly guide will greet you.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Changing your PIN resets biometric unlock. Set a new fingerprint or face after any PIN change so quick unlock keeps working.
